articles.title: Jupiter: The Gas Giant That Rules Its Own Mini Solar System
articles.summary: Jupiter is a failed star with a storm bigger than Earth and a moon that might harbor alien life. Its radiation could kill you in minutes—but the views are out of this world.

articles.title: 'Brotherhood' Trailer: A Musical About Immigration, Empathy, and the Power of Neighborly Love
articles.summary: Broadway's Mauricio Martínez leads a new cinematic musical about a Mexican immigrant and his American neighbor. With 13 original songs, it's a story about seeing beyond labels—and it hits theaters October 9.

articles.title: Usher & Chris Brown's R&B Tour: Surprise Guests, Viral Moments, and a Dream Team-Up
articles.summary: Usher and Chris Brown's co-headlining tour has been a summer sensation, with surprise guests like 50 Cent and Mary J. Blige. Usher even kicked a disinterested fan off stage—and the video went viral.
